agent_explanation: Sustained force saturation precedes the failure: steps 332-333 report controller_force exactly equal to fmax (156.009), showing the saturation clamp was active. On step 334 the same tracking task (body 0 ~1.5m from waypoint, speed ~12.9) demands a force above fmax, but the reported force 214.479 passes through unclamped. Likely cause is a faulty saturation/clamp branch that fails intermittently (e.g. only on the final step / after prolonged saturation), letting the raw kp velocity-error law output through instead of min(|F|,fmax).
